name: Harmonic Signature Reformulation
description: Replaces the direct "diversity product" exact-cover condition with a sum of powers of 2. Since the binary popcount of the sum of k powers of 2 is at most k, and 2^k - 1 has exactly k ones, the equation sum(2^(v-1)) = 2^k - 1 is satisfied if and only if all k values are distinct. This strictly enforces the 3D matching constraint while requiring mathematical deduction to uncover the exact-cover nature of the task.
